newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Microchip, Altera EPS upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Microchip, Altera EPS upped.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co analyst Dan Niles raised his earnings estimates on Microchip Technology Inc and Altera Corp, citing continued improving conditions in the semiconductor market, his assistant said. Microchip shares rose 3-1/4 to 52-3/4.
He raised Microchip Technology's full year 1997 to an estimated $1.58 a share from $1.54 previously and his 1998 estimate to $2.20 a share from $2.05 previously.
On Altera, he raised his fourth quarter 1996 estimate to $0.56 a share from $0.54 and his 1997 year estimate to $2.75 a share from $2.50 previously. Shares rose one to 74-1/8.
